passages.heading: MD&A
passages.text: The following discussion and analysis of our financial condition and results of operations should be read together with the consolidated financial statements and related notes included in Item 8. Financial Statements and Supplementary Data . See Item 7. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition, and Results of Operations in our 202 4 Form 10-K for a discussion of our financial condition and results of operations for the year ended December 31, 2023 and for the year ended December 31, 2024 compared to the year ended December 31, 2023, which is incorporated here by reference. 51 VISTRA CORP. Key Financial Results The following are financial and operating highlights we achieved in the execution of our four strategic priorities: Long-term, attractive earnings profile through the integrated business model. • We continued to execute our integrated business model, delivering strong operational and financial performance while responding effectively to market opportunities. Our ability to combine a diversified and dependable generation fleet with a scaled retail platform and disciplined wholesale risk management capabilities remains a core competitive advantage and supports more stable and predictable cash flows across commodity price cycles. • Long-term contracts entered in 2025 underwrite higher base profitability in the future. ◦ In September 2025, we announced that we had entered into a 20-year power purchase agreement (PPA) (with options to extend for up to an additional 20 years) with Amazon Web Services (AWS) to supply 1,200 MW of carbon-free power from our Comanche Peak Nuclear Power Plant. We anticipate power delivery to begin in the fourth quarter of 2027 and ramp to full capacity by 2032. ◦ In January 2026, we announced that we had entered into 20-year PPAs with Meta Platforms, Inc. (Meta) to supply 2,609 MW of carbon-free power and capacity from our PJM nuclear power plants, including 2,176 MW of operating energy and capacity and 433 of uprate energy and capacity to be constructed. We anticipate commencing delivery on a portion of the operating energy and capacity in late 2026 and full delivery by year end 2027. We anticipate commencing delivery on a portion of the uprate energy and capacity by 2031 and full delivery by year end 2034. Disciplined capital allocation. • Executed disciplined capital allocation through targeted natural gas expansion, including the development of an 860 MW facility in West Texas and the acquisition of 2,600 MW of natural gas generation capacity from Lotus. • In December 2025, we executed definitive agreements to acquire Cogentrix Energy, consisting of 10 natural gas generation facilities totaling approximately 5,500 MW of capacity. The transaction is expected to close in mid-to-late 2026. • During the year ended December 31, 2025, we paid dividends to common stockholders totaling $306 million. • In October 2025, the Board authorized an incremental amount of $1.0 billion under our stock repurchase program established in October 2021. passages.heading: Risk factors
passages.text: . The Sustainability and Risk Committee of the Board has been delegated oversight responsibility of Vistra's Information Security. Vistra periodically engages third-party advisors to provide cybersecurity oversight and tabletop training to the full Board to further our commitment to responsible oversight of cybersecurity risk management. At least quarterly, our CIO reports to the Sustainability and Risk Committee of the Board on our Information Security program, including cybersecurity risks and threats (including the emerging threat landscape), an assessment of our Information Security program, and the status of projects to strengthen our Information Security program. In furtherance of our commitment to responsible oversight of cybersecurity risk management, in 2023, the Board appointed a director who brings extensive cybersecurity expertise to the Board. 46 VISTRA CORP. Our CIO serves as head of Vistra's Technology Services and is responsible for ensuring the reliability, security, and continued development of the Company's technology platforms and delivering new solutions to support the business. The CIO has served in various senior information technology roles in public companies for over 30 years, including Keurig Dr. Pepper Inc., General Motors, Pfizer, and Electronic Data Systems. Our CISO has over 24 years of information technology experience. He has held technology positions across various areas, including infrastructure management, application management, architecture, operations, and cybersecurity, and brings expertise from Farmers Insurance and Zurich Insurance. credit_strengths.text: Vistra's integrated generation and retail platform supports stable cash flows, with operating cash flow exceeding capital expenditures and covering dividends and buybacks. The company's scale and diversified fleet provide a competitive advantage across commodity cycles, as noted in the MD&A. This cash generation underpins debt servicing capacity despite high leverage.

Long-term power purchase agreements with investment-grade counterparties underwrite future profitability and reduce merchant risk. The AWS and Meta contracts extend for decades, providing revenue visibility and supporting credit quality. These contracts enhance the predictability of cash flows, which is critical given the capital-intensive nature of the business.

key_risks.text: Leverage remains elevated, with net debt to EBITDA above the sector median and an aggressive indicative financial risk profile. The company's debt burden has increased over the past three years, and interest coverage is weak relative to peers. This limits financial flexibility and increases vulnerability to earnings volatility.

The company faces significant refinancing needs, with a substantial portion of debt maturing in the next two years. Additionally, the MD&A discloses ongoing capital allocation toward acquisitions and shareholder returns, which could strain liquidity if cash flows decline. The current ratio below one indicates potential short-term liquidity pressure.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Operating cash flow covers interest expense and capital expenditures, but free cash flow to debt is modest. The company's ability to service debt relies on sustained cash generation, which could be challenged by commodity price swings or operational disruptions. Interest coverage is below the sector median, indicating limited headroom.

Debt maturities are manageable in the near term, but the company will need to refinance a significant portion of its debt in the coming years. The maturity profile shows concentrations in the next two years, requiring access to capital markets. Refinancing risk is mitigated by the company's scale and asset base, but leverage remains a constraint.

overall_credit_view.text: Vistra's credit profile is characterized by high leverage and weak interest coverage, offset by stable cash flows from a diversified fleet and long-term contracts. The indicative financial risk profile is aggressive, and the company's leverage sits above the sector median. We view the credit as speculative grade, with limited headroom for adverse developments.

The company's capital allocation strategy prioritizes shareholder returns and growth investments, which may constrain deleveraging. However, the long-term contracts and integrated model provide a foundation for cash flow stability. We expect leverage to remain elevated, and any deterioration in operating performance could pressure the credit profile.

credit_strengths.text: Vistra的綜合發電及零售平台支持穩定現金流，營運現金流超過資本支出並足以支付股息及回購。正如管理層討論與分析所述，公司的規模及多元化機組在商品週期中提供競爭優勢。儘管槓桿高企，此現金產生能力仍支撐償債能力。
與投資級交易對手簽訂的長期購電協議保障未來盈利能力並降低商業風險。AWS及Meta的合約為期數十年，提供收入可見性並支持信貸質量。這些合約增強現金流的可預測性，鑑於業務屬資本密集型，此點至關重要。

key_risks.text: 槓桿仍然高企，淨債務對EBITDA比率高於行業中位數，且指示性財務風險狀況進取。過去三年公司的債務負擔增加，利息覆蓋率相對同業疲弱。這限制財務靈活性並增加對盈利波動的脆弱性。
公司面臨重大再融資需求，相當部分債務將於未來兩年內到期。此外，管理層討論與分析披露持續將資本配置於收購及股東回報，若現金流下降可能對流動性構成壓力。流動比率低於一顯示潛在短期流動性壓力。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 營運現金流覆蓋利息支出及資本支出，但自由現金流對債務的比率適中。公司償債能力依賴持續現金產生，商品價格波動或營運中斷可能對其構成挑戰。利息覆蓋率低於行業中位數，顯示緩衝空間有限。
債務到期在短期內可控，但公司將需在未來數年為相當部分債務再融資。到期結構顯示未來兩年集中，需要進入資本市場。再融資風險因公司規模及資產基礎而緩解，但槓桿仍構成限制。

overall_credit_view.text: Vistra的信貸狀況特點為高槓桿及疲弱利息覆蓋率，但由多元化機組及長期合約帶來的穩定現金流所抵銷。指示性財務風險狀況為進取，公司槓桿高於行業中位數。我們認為該信貸屬投機級別，對不利發展的緩衝空間有限。
公司的資本配置策略優先考慮股東回報及增長投資，可能限制去槓桿。然而，長期合約及綜合模式為現金流穩定性提供基礎。我們預期槓桿將維持高企，營運表現任何惡化均可能對信貸狀況構成壓力。
